practice_tasks.title: Power iteration for the top eigenpair
practice_tasks.description: The top eigenvalue and eigenvector of a symmetric matrix by power iteration, with a tolerance, an iteration limit and a sign rule. From [Singular Value Decomposition](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F01-math-foundations%2F11-singular-value-decomposition)

practice_tasks.title: Vectorized pairwise distances
practice_tasks.description: Euclidean distance and cosine similarity matrices from one matrix product, with a clip at 0 and a zero-vector rule. From [Norms and Distances](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F01-math-foundations%2F14-norms-and-distances)

practice_tasks.title: Linear regression by gradient descent
practice_tasks.description: Mean squared error, its gradients for weights and bias, and a batch gradient descent loop that records the cost after each update. From [Linear Regression](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F02-linear-regression)

practice_tasks.title: Logistic regression from scratch
practice_tasks.description: A stable sigmoid, the binary cross-entropy loss and its gradient, and a gradient descent loop that records the loss. From [Logistic Regression](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F03-logistic-regression)

practice_tasks.title: Gini impurity and the best split
practice_tasks.description: Gini impurity and the best decision tree split over all features, with midpoint thresholds, weighted child impurity and a fixed tie rule. From [Decision Trees and Random Forests](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F04-decision-trees)

practice_tasks.title: K-means assignment and update
practice_tasks.description: The k-means assignment and update steps with a tie rule and an empty cluster rule, and a full run until the assignments stop changing. From [Unsupervised Learning](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F07-unsupervised-learning)

practice_tasks.title: Backpropagation through a two-layer MLP
practice_tasks.description: Forward pass with a cache and a backward pass that returns the gradient of every weight and bias of a two-layer sigmoid network. From [Backpropagation from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F03-backpropagation)

practice_tasks.title: Stable softmax and cross-entropy
practice_tasks.description: Batched softmax, mean cross-entropy and its gradient, without overflow for large logits. From [Loss Functions](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F05-loss-functions)

practice_tasks.title: SGD with momentum
practice_tasks.description: One momentum update with the lesson's velocity rule, and a loop that minimizes a quadratic with or without Nesterov lookahead. From [Optimizers](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F06-optimizers)

practice_tasks.title: Adam and AdamW step
practice_tasks.description: One Adam update with bias correction and a step counter that starts at 1, plus AdamW decoupled weight decay, as a pure function of the state. From [Optimizers](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F06-optimizers)

practice_tasks.title: Inverted dropout
practice_tasks.description: Inverted dropout with a given random generator: training forward with an exact mask, backward with the same mask, identity at inference. From [Regularization](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F07-regularization)

practice_tasks.title: Batch normalization forward and backward
practice_tasks.description: Training and inference forward passes with running statistics, and the full backward pass for x, gamma and beta. From [Regularization](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F07-regularization)

practice_tasks.title: Beam search with EOS and length normalization
practice_tasks.description: Keep the best beam_width partial sequences over a step function, finish beams at EOS, and rank them with a length penalty. From [Sequence-to-Sequence Models](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F05-nlp-foundations-to-advanced%2F09-sequence-to-sequence)

practice_tasks.title: BM25 ranking
practice_tasks.description: Score tokenized documents against a query with BM25: the lesson idf, term frequency saturation with k1, length normalization with b, and a ranked list. From [Information Retrieval and Search](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F05-nlp-foundations-to-advanced%2F14-information-retrieval-search)

practice_tasks.title: Scaled dot-product attention with a mask
practice_tasks.description: Batched softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V with an optional boolean mask, plus the causal mask that a decoder uses. From [Self-Attention from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F02-self-attention-from-scratch)

practice_tasks.title: Split heads, merge heads, multi-head attention
practice_tasks.description: Reshape (B, T, D) into H heads and back, then run batched multi-head self-attention with given projection matrices. From [Multi-Head Attention](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F03-multi-head-attention)

practice_tasks.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
practice_tasks.description: Build the sin and cos position table with interleaved columns and base 10000, and add it to a batch of token embeddings. From [Positional Encoding — Sinusoidal, RoPE, ALiBi](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F04-positional-encoding)

practice_tasks.title: Rotary position embedding
practice_tasks.description: Rotate adjacent coordinate pairs of queries and keys by position times base^(-2i/d), so attention scores depend only on the position gap. From [Positional Encoding — Sinusoidal, RoPE, ALiBi](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F04-positional-encoding)

practice_tasks.title: LayerNorm and RMSNorm
practice_tasks.description: LayerNorm with gamma and beta and RMSNorm with a weight, both over the last axis, with eps inside the square root. From [The Full Transformer — Encoder + Decoder](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F05-full-transformer)

practice_tasks.title: Temperature, top-k and top-p sampling
practice_tasks.description: Scale logits by temperature, keep the top k or the top p mass, renormalize, and draw one token with a seeded rng. From [GPT — Causal Language Modeling](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F07-gpt-causal-language-modeling)

practice_tasks.title: Fixed-capacity KV cache
practice_tasks.description: Append keys and values to a preallocated cache, attend one query over the valid prefix, and reject an append past the capacity. From [KV Cache, Flash Attention & Inference Optimization](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F12-kv-cache-flash-attention)

practice_tasks.title: Q-learning and SARSA updates
practice_tasks.description: One tabular Q-learning or SARSA update with no bootstrap at a terminal step, and epsilon-greedy actions from a seeded rng with lowest-index ties. From [Temporal Difference — Q-Learning & SARSA](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F09-reinforcement-learning%2F04-q-learning-sarsa)

practice_tasks.title: Discounted returns with episode ends
practice_tasks.description: Reward-to-go returns for one episode and for a batch of joined episodes with done flags, plus return normalization. From [Policy Gradient — REINFORCE from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F09-reinforcement-learning%2F06-policy-gradients-reinforce)

practice_tasks.title: Generalized advantage estimation
practice_tasks.description: TD errors and GAE advantages with gamma, lambda, done flags and a bootstrap value, plus the critic targets. From [Actor-Critic — A2C and A3C](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F09-reinforcement-learning%2F07-actor-critic-a2c-a3c)

practice_tasks.title: PPO clipped surrogate loss
practice_tasks.description: The PPO loss to minimize from new and old log probabilities and advantages, the clip fraction, and the gradient with respect to the new log probabilities. From [Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F09-reinforcement-learning%2F08-ppo)

practice_tasks.title: Symmetric int8 quantization
practice_tasks.description: Absmax int8 quantization with one scale per tensor and one scale per row, with dequantization and a zero-row rule. From [Quantization: Making Models Fit](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F10-llms-from-scratch%2F11-quantization)

practice_tasks.title: Cosine similarity top-k search
practice_tasks.description: Normalize embedding rows, score queries against documents with cosine similarity, and return the top k documents with a fixed tie rule. From [Embeddings & Vector Representations](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F11-llm-engineering%2F04-embeddings)

practice_tasks.title: LoRA linear layer
practice_tasks.description: Forward pass of a linear layer with a low rank adapter, merge of the adapter into the weight, and the trainable parameter count. From [Fine-Tuning with LoRA & QLoRA](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F11-llm-engineering%2F08-fine-tuning-lora)

practice_tasks.title: Parse and validate tool calls
practice_tasks.description: Parse tool calls from a raw model reply and validate their arguments against a JSON Schema subset with JSON pointer error paths. From [Tool Registry with Schema Validation](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F19-capstone-projects%2F21-tool-registry-schema-validation)

practice_tasks.title: BPE pair counts and merges
practice_tasks.description: Count weighted adjacent pairs, pick the best pair with a fixed tie rule, merge it without overlap and train a BPE merge list. From [BPE Tokenizer From Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F19-capstone-projects%2F30-bpe-tokenizer-from-scratch)

practice_tasks.title: Reciprocal rank fusion
practice_tasks.description: Merge several ranked lists of document ids into one ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, optional list weights and a fixed tie rule. From [Hybrid Retrieval with BM25 and Dense Embeddings](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F19-capstone-projects%2F65-hybrid-retrieval-bm25-dense)

practice_tasks.title: Focal loss
practice_tasks.description: Binary and multi-class focal loss with gamma and alpha, from logits and without overflow, plus the binary gradient. From [Loss Functions](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F05-loss-functions)

practice_tasks.title: CLIP symmetric contrastive loss
practice_tasks.description: Normalize image and text embeddings, build the temperature-scaled similarity matrix, and compute the symmetric InfoNCE loss and its gradient. From [Open-Vocabulary Vision — CLIP](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F04-computer-vision%2F18-open-vocab-clip)

practice_tasks.title: Grouped-query attention
practice_tasks.description: GQA forward with H query heads and G shared key and value groups, plus mean pooling of a multi-head checkpoint into groups. From [Multi-Head Attention](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F03-multi-head-attention)

practice_tasks.title: Top-k MoE gating and the Switch load-balancing loss
practice_tasks.description: Route tokens to the top k experts with renormalized softmax gates, and compute the Switch Transformer auxiliary loss E times sum f_i P_i. From [Mixture of Experts (MoE)](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F11-mixture-of-experts)

practice_tasks.title: Tiled attention with an online softmax
practice_tasks.description: FlashAttention in numpy: a running max and a running sum over key blocks give exact attention for any block size. From [KV Cache, Flash Attention & Inference Optimization](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F12-kv-cache-flash-attention)

practice_tasks.title: Speculative decoding: accept, reject and resample
practice_tasks.description: The min(1, p/q) acceptance rule and the residual distribution that keep speculative decoding exactly equal to the target model. From [Speculative Decoding — Draft, Verify, Repeat](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F16-speculative-decoding)

practice_tasks.title: DDPM noise schedule, closed form noising and posterior
practice_tasks.description: Build the linear beta schedule and alpha bars, sample x_t from x_0 in closed form, and compute the mean and variance of q(x_{t-1} | x_t, x_0). From [Diffusion Models — DDPM from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F08-generative-ai%2F06-diffusion-ddpm-from-scratch)

practice_tasks.title: Rectified flow loss and Euler sampler
practice_tasks.description: Interpolate along straight paths, regress the velocity x1 - x0 with the flow matching loss, and integrate a velocity field with Euler steps. From [Flow Matching & Rectified Flows](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F08-generative-ai%2F13-flow-matching-rectified-flows)

practice_tasks.title: GRPO group advantages and clipped objective
practice_tasks.description: Normalize rewards within each group, estimate the KL with k3, and compute the clipped GRPO objective averaged per answer over valid tokens. From [RL for Games — AlphaZero, MuZero, and the LLM-Reasoning Era](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F09-reinforcement-learning%2F12-rl-for-games)

practice_tasks.title: DPO loss and implicit rewards
practice_tasks.description: The direct preference optimization loss, its implicit rewards and its gradient, from policy and reference log probabilities. From [DPO: Direct Preference Optimization](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F10-llms-from-scratch%2F08-dpo)

practice_tasks.title: Train softmax regression on four blobs
practice_tasks.description: Train multinomial logistic regression with gradient descent to reach a held-out accuracy and log loss target on four Gaussian blobs. From [Logistic Regression](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F03-logistic-regression)

practice_tasks.title: Train a 2-4-1 network on XOR
practice_tasks.description: Train a small sigmoid network with full-batch gradient descent until it labels noisy XOR points with 95 percent held-out accuracy. From [Backpropagation from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F03-backpropagation)

practice_tasks.title: Fit a sine curve with a tanh network
practice_tasks.description: Train a 1-16-1 tanh network on noisy samples of sin(x) until its held-out mean squared error against the true curve is below 0.01. From [Activation Functions](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F04-activation-functions)

practice_tasks.title: Train a tanh network on two spirals
practice_tasks.description: Train a 2-24-24-1 tanh network with mini-batch Adam until it separates two noisy spirals with 95 percent held-out accuracy. From [Build Your Own Mini Framework](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F10-mini-framework)

practice_tasks.title: Train a character bigram language model
practice_tasks.description: Train a table of next-character logits with gradient descent until the held-out negative log-likelihood beats a unigram model. From [Text Generation Before Transformers — N-gram Language Models](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F05-nlp-foundations-to-advanced%2F16-text-generation-pre-transformer)

practice_tasks.title: Measure bias and variance
practice_tasks.description: Fit polynomials of degree 1 to 12 on resampled training sets and measure bias squared, variance and test error at each degree. From [Bias-Variance Tradeoff](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F02-ml-fundamentals%2F10-bias-variance)

practice_tasks.title: Sweep the learning rate
practice_tasks.description: Sweep gradient descent learning rates on a seeded regression, find the best rate and the first rate that diverges, and compare with 2 over the top eigenvalue. From [Learning Rate Schedules and Warmup](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F03-deep-learning-core%2F09-learning-rate-schedules)

practice_tasks.title: Sweep the sampling temperature
practice_tasks.description: Sweep the temperature on fixed logits, measure entropy and top 1 probability, find where entropy crosses 2 bits, and count the tokens top p keeps. From [GPT — Causal Language Modeling](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F07-transformers-deep-dive%2F07-gpt-causal-language-modeling)

practice_tasks.title: Sweep the quantization bit width
practice_tasks.description: Sweep symmetric absmax quantization from 2 to 8 bits on weights with outliers, compare one scale per tensor with one scale per row. From [Quantization: Making Models Fit](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F10-llms-from-scratch%2F11-quantization)

practice_tasks.title: Read an SGLang sweep on an L4
practice_tasks.description: Use real SGLang runs on an NVIDIA L4 to find the saturation point, the SLO limit, the FP8 gain and the effect of a smaller prefill chunk. From [Inference Metrics — TTFT, TPOT, ITL, Goodput, P99](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/lesson?path=phases%2F17-infrastructure-and-production%2F08-inference-metrics-goodput)
